guidePage.title: Self-service kiosk: what it is, how it works and how to choose one
guidePage.lead: Short and to the point — for owners of restaurants, cafés and fast-food venues in Tashkent and across Uzbekistan.

what.p1: A self-service kiosk is a touchscreen terminal where guests choose their food, customise the order and pay without waiting for a cashier. The order goes straight to the kitchen, and the guest collects it by number.
what.p2: In quick-service restaurants these kiosks are long familiar — McDonald's and Shake Shack, for example, use them widely. Today self-service terminals also appear in coffee shops, bakeries, food courts and fast-casual cafés.

how.h: How ordering at a kiosk works
how.s1: The guest picks a language and browses a menu with photos.
how.s2: Adds items and chooses modifiers and combos.
how.s3: The kiosk suggests an add-on — a drink, a dessert or a sauce.
how.s4: The guest pays by card or QR code.
how.s5: The order gets a number and goes to the kitchen; the guest collects it at the pickup point.

who.p: A kiosk pays off where there are many guests and a clear menu:

benefits.h: What a kiosk gives the business
benefits.i1: Orders are taken in parallel — no line piles up at a single till.
benefits.i2: The team works the kitchen and the floor, not order entry.
benefits.i3: Add-on suggestions in every order — consistently, not when someone remembers.
benefits.i4: Fewer mistakes: guests build the order themselves and confirm it on screen.
benefits.i5: A menu in Uzbek, Russian and English.
benefits.p: Public industry data shows kiosk orders tend to be larger on average. Sources are in the

parts.h: What a kiosk is made of
parts.i1: An enclosure — floor-standing, countertop or wall-mounted.
parts.i3: A payment terminal for cards and QR payments.
parts.i4: A receipt printer that prints the order number.
parts.i5: Ordering software with your menu and branding.

choose.h: How to choose a self-service kiosk
choose.i1: Payments: do the methods your guests use work — Click, Payme, Uzum, Uzcard, HUMO, Visa and Mastercard?
choose.i2: Languages: the interface should speak Uzbek and Russian with guests, and English with tourists.
choose.i3: Till and kitchen: how orders reach your back-office system — worth agreeing before you buy.
choose.i4: Size and space: how much free floor space you have and how many kiosks your guest flow needs.
choose.i5: Service: who installs the kiosk, trains the team and supports it after launch.
choose.i6: Buy or rent: renting lowers the upfront investment.

price.h: How much a self-service kiosk costs
price.p1: The price depends on the number of kiosks, their configuration, the size of the menu and the integrations you need. That's why an honest figure comes after a short assessment of your venue.
price.p2: If you'd rather not invest in hardware upfront, you can rent the kiosk — with a low initial payment and support included.

kiyo.p: kiyo handles the whole path: assessment, menu and interface setup, installation, staff training and support.

privacyPage.title: Privacy notice
privacyPage.intro: This notice explains what happens to the information you submit through this website and how analytics and cookies are used.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.text: When you submit the contact form, we collect the data you enter: your name, phone number, business name (optional) and message (optional). Technical context is stored alongside it: the page you submitted from, the referrer, UTM parameters, the site language and the submission time.

s2.title: Why we collect it
s2.text: For one purpose: to contact you about self-service kiosks — to call you back, answer questions and prepare a proposal. We do not sell or share this data with third parties for marketing.

s3.title: Where it is stored
s3.text: Submissions are stored in a private Google Sheets document operated by the company. Data is processed in Google's infrastructure and may be stored on servers outside Uzbekistan.

s4.title: Who can access it
s4.text: Only staff who handle sales and implementation have access, granted individually through Google accounts.

s5.title: Correction and deletion
s5.text: You may request to see, correct or delete your submitted data at any time — contact us through any channel on the contact page.

s6.title: Analytics
s6.text: The site may use Vercel Analytics, Vercel Speed Insights, Google Analytics 4 and Yandex Metrica for aggregate usage statistics. Analytics events never include the content of your submissions, your phone number or your name.

s7.title: Cookies
s7.text: The site uses a cookie to remember your language choice (NEXT_LOCALE). Analytics services, when enabled, may set their own cookies according to their policies.

s8.title: Legal entity
s8.text: The final legal entity, registration details and controller contacts will be published here before commercial launch. This notice must be reviewed by legal counsel before public use.
